title: Nobody walks around town who is not here
lines: Members who are in a game, asleep or gone no longer walk around town. They fade in and out where they are.

more.head: Changed
points: A raid party no longer walks in through the gate. The town still cheers, the lantern still goes up, and party members who are in town cheer where they are.
Someone who leaves a game stands at their spot for 2 minutes, then fades out. If their character stays in town and a seat is free, they fade in asleep on it.
Sleepers stay on their seats when someone else sits down. You can no longer sit on someone who is asleep.
With a game open on one device and the town open on another, you count as in the game until you leave it.
